content.text: Skip to main content Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival Held annually at the Empire Polo Club in the beautiful Southern California desert, The Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival is the biggest music event on the planet, attracting over 250,000 fans across two weekends and seen by tens of millions globally. Coachella combines groundbreaking artists from all genres of music with extraordinary art installations and delicious culinary and drink experiences. Multiple stages – including Coachella Stage, Outdoor Theatre, Gobi, Mojave, Sahara, Yuma, and the newest Sonora – have hosted performances by Beyoncé, Prince, The Weeknd, Harry Styles, AC/DC, Gun N’ Roses, Radiohead, LCD Soundsystem, Jack White, Muse, Billie Eilish, and thousands more.
